sanskrit:

धृष्टद्युम्नो विराटश्च सात्यकिश्चापराजितः ॥ १-१७॥
iast:
kāśyaśca parameṣvāsaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca mahārathaḥ
dhṛṣṭadyumno virāṭaśca sātyakiścāparājitaḥ 1-17
translation: The king of Kashi, an excellent archer, Shikhandi, the mighty commander of eleven thousand archers, Dhristadyumna and Virata and Satyaki, the unconquered;
